priceSnapshot.note: Down from endday's close (84,295.1 -> 83,137.3, -1.37% session-over-session; -1.60% vs the 24h open of 84,490.1). Broke below both 84,125 and 83,818 with confirmed 15m/1H closes within the first hour after endday, then wicked through the 82,874.5 support to a fresh session low (82,716.8) on a violent long-liquidation cascade before bouncing back to the 83,050-83,150 zone.

reduceIf.confirmation: A confirmed 15m/1H close below 82,874.5 (wicked to 82,716.8 this session but held on a closing basis) opens a retest of 82,500 and then the next daily swing low near 80,588.

addIf.confirmation: A confirmed 1H/4H close back above 83,818 (broken with confirmed closes early this session, now resistance) would mark the flush as reclaimed. Until then, treat adds as small/opportunistic buys into defended support, not breakout chases.

decisionBox.changed: Small spot-core DCA add (~20 USDT) after price wicked through the 82,874.5 support to a fresh low (82,716.8, a violent long-liquidation cascade -- $651.2k longs vs $19.1k shorts liquidated in OKX's last-100-fills sample, ~34:1) then bounced back to ~83,100-83,150 with 1H RSI oversold (30.2). Confirmed 15m/1H closes below both 84,125 and 83,818 (both now resistance) show real medium-term weakness -- 4H MACD histogram deepened to -147.94 (from -24.12 at endday). The daily trend stays intact (RSI 58.54, price above all daily EMAs including EMA200 at 71,485.4), so this is measured accumulation at a defended support level, not a reversal call or a momentum chase.
